title: Microsoft Teams: live captions get a right-side panel and one settings menu
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates and automatic availability match Microsoft's notice, and the existing live captions policy and PowerShell control are documented. The translated-captions licensing statement includes the large-audience-event exception, and searches found no separately documented tenant switch or pricing for the new layout and menu.

claims.claim: The live captions control is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Live captions.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. From the drop-down for Live captions, select Not enabled, but users can enable(default value) or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -LiveCaptionsEnabledType Disabled turns off live captions for users assigned that policy.
claims.quote: To turn off live captions for users with this policy, run the following script: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -LiveCaptionsEnabledType Disabled
